en.atelier.meta.title: The atelier · forma
en.atelier.sub: One wedding, from the first inquiry to the last dance, exactly as forma carries it. Then the honest comparison, gaps included.
en.atelier.s1.p: A proposal presented, a contract signed by both, a deposit paid through Stripe. Nothing printed, nothing chased, nothing lost between three tools.
en.atelier.s2.p: Quotes, bookings and payments tracked to the line, per wedding and across the studio. The budget updates itself as the wedding takes shape.
en.atelier.s3.p: The budget, the decisions and the schedule, live in the couple's hands. Approvals happen in the portal instead of over Sunday messages.
en.atelier.s4.h2: RSVP, meal and seat, gathered once.
en.atelier.s4.p: Guests answer one elegant page. Meals, allergies and plus-ones collect themselves, and the seating chart draws from real answers, not a spreadsheet.
en.atelier.s5.h2: The run of show, in every hand.
en.atelier.s5.p: One timeline for the whole cast: every vendor gets their call time, every guest their schedule, your coordinator the door list. Written once, delivered everywhere.
en.atelier.s6.p: The whole studio at a glance, with the concierge keeping watch across all of it: what moved, what waits, what needs your eye this morning.
en.atelier.cmp.sub: Named, dated and defensible, cell by cell. Both are real tools, good at their jobs; the differences below are why forma exists.
en.atelier.cmp.r9: AI that works inside the weddings
en.atelier.cmp.fine: Compared August 2026, from public pages and documentation. Three rows are not ours yet, and we say so; they are why the roadmap looks the way it does.
en.atelier.close.h2: See it with your own weddings.

en.about.meta.title: About · forma
en.about.h1: A wedding atelier, not another tool.
en.about.sub: forma is built by planners who plan weddings: multi city, multi event, in more than one language, with the day itself as the deadline. It exists because the whole wedding deserved one place, and the tools of the trade never gave it one.
en.about.env.h2: The star is older than the industry.
en.about.env.p: Our mark is the eight point star: two squares, one center, a form that has meant order and completeness since it was pressed into clay four thousand years ago. The oldest gardens of Persia were drawn the same way, four quarters gathered around a single point, and their name, pairi daeza, became the word paradise. That is the work, as we understand it: every part of the wedding, drawn to one center.
en.about.pr1.name: Composure
en.about.pr1.text: The planner with forma is composed, in command, and present for the craft and the couple. Everything we build serves that posture.
en.about.pr2.name: Honesty
en.about.pr2.text: Real numbers, dated claims, gaps admitted. Pricing in plain sight and a comparison that marks the rows we have not won yet.
en.about.pr3.name: Show, then say
en.about.pr3.text: The product is the proof. We would rather walk you through a seating chart than write an adjective about one.
en.about.pr4.name: Four languages, equals
en.about.pr4.text: English, Spanish, French and Italian, written as four originals. A wedding crosses borders; its software should cross them natively. Every wedding is kept in its own currency, every conversation in its own language.
en.about.close.h2: Plan the next one with us.

fr.about.meta.title: À propos · forma
fr.about.h1: Un atelier de mariage, pas un outil de plus.
fr.about.sub: forma est construit par des planners qui planifient des mariages : plusieurs villes, plusieurs événements, plus d'une langue, avec le jour lui-même pour échéance. Il existe parce que le mariage entier méritait un seul lieu, et que les outils du métier ne le lui ont jamais donné.
fr.about.env.h2: L'étoile est plus ancienne que l'industrie.
fr.about.env.p: Notre marque est l'étoile à huit pointes : deux carrés, un centre, une forme qui dit l'ordre et la complétude depuis qu'elle fut pressée dans l'argile il y a quatre mille ans. Les plus anciens jardins de Perse étaient dessinés ainsi, quatre quartiers réunis autour d'un seul point, et leur nom, pairi daeza, est devenu le mot paradis. C'est cela le travail, tel que nous l'entendons : chaque partie du mariage, ramenée vers un centre.
fr.about.pr1.name: L'aplomb
fr.about.pr1.text: La planner avec forma est posée, aux commandes, présente pour le métier et pour le couple. Tout ce que nous construisons sert cette posture.
fr.about.pr2.name: L'honnêteté
fr.about.pr2.text: Des chiffres réels, des affirmations datées, des lacunes admises. Des tarifs en pleine lumière et une comparaison qui marque les lignes que nous n'avons pas encore gagnées.
fr.about.pr3.name: Montrer, puis dire
fr.about.pr3.text: Le produit est la preuve. Nous préférons vous faire traverser un plan de table plutôt qu'écrire un adjectif à son sujet.
fr.about.pr4.name: Quatre langues, égales
fr.about.pr4.text: Anglais, espagnol, français et italien, écrits comme quatre originaux. Un mariage traverse les frontières ; son logiciel devrait les traverser nativement. Chaque mariage est tenu dans sa propre monnaie, chaque conversation dans sa propre langue.

it.about.meta.title: Chi siamo · forma

it.about.env.h2: La stella è più antica dell'industria.

I giardini più antichi della Persia erano disegnati così, quattro quarti raccolti attorno a un solo punto, e il loro nome, pairi daeza, divenne la parola paradiso.
